# The muzzle flash: a four-pointed star 0.5 m across in the play plane, unlit cyan.
new
material new Flash --base-color 0.424 0.929 0.929 --emission 0.424 0.929 0.929 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name H --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.5 0.08 0.12
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name V --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.12 0.08 0.5
apply --scale
select H V
material assign Flash
active H
join
shade flat
export flash.glb
